rules.statement: A Court should be slow to give an unconditional special direction for partition that includes improvements made by a co-owner unless the Court is satisfied, upon examination of all relevant considerations, that such a scheme is practicable and just.
rules.supporting_quote: But a Court should, I think, be slow to make such a direction unconditionally, unless the Court has perfectly satisfied itself, upon an examination of all the relevant considerations, that such a scheme of partition is practicable and just.
